title: AdServices attribution token collection enabled
what: The app enables AdServices attribution token collection after the RevenueCat configure call.
how: Read the code.

title: App secrets set and mirrored to the encrypted env
what: App secrets are set on GitHub and mirrored into the SOPS env under the app prefix. The Worker binding stays unprefixed. The Lock In language family shares one family prefix by documented exception (conflict secret-naming, resolved).
how: Follow analytics-per-app section 3. Verify a secret by hash, never by printing it.

title: Attribution pipe verified before paid spend scales
what: The attribution pipe is verified end to end before paid spend scales: ad network, MMP, subscription system, backend identity, dedupe, optimizer feedback.
how: Use the vendor field checklist on the concept page. For paid UA frameworks see the linked-only ua-skills notes.

title: Funnel metrics compared with the benchmark bands
what: Trial start, trial-to-paid and install-to-paid are compared with the benchmark bands.
how: Read the bands in the paywall playbook Benchmarks section. Put the comparison in the weekly report.

title: Device context on every event
what: Each event has the nine device context user properties, set by the native Swift client (conflict analytics-client-platform, resolved: the Expo sections are stale).
how: Open one event in the Amplitude event view.

title: Every experiment has a ledger file with a DECIDED line
what: Each experiment has a ledger file with hypothesis, arms, dates and a DECIDED line. No file means no experiment. The source cadence is per experiment.
how: Create the file in docs/experiments/<app>/ before the experiment starts. kb-site EXPERIMENTS.md is the cross-repo index.

title: Extension events are buffered, the app sends them
what: Extension events are buffered and sent by the app, not by the extensions.
how: Read the extension code; no network call.

title: Funnel constraint diagnosed before traffic is added
what: The current funnel constraint is diagnosed before traffic is added. More traffic makes a leak more expensive.
how: Name the constraint step and its number in the weekly report.

title: One funnel dashboard exists before launch
what: One funnel dashboard exists in the EU analytics project before launch.
how: Link the dashboard in the app's private docs (the URL is private).

title: Marketing measured by funnel progression
what: Marketing is measured by funnel progression (views, downloads, conversions, low churn), never by views alone.
how: Report each channel with all funnel steps.

title: Every live experiment is in the weekly report
what: Each live experiment is listed in the weekly report. Nothing runs silently. The source cadence is weekly. The wiki status date 2026-08-01 is the growth-ops ratification date (conflict wiki-autonomy-rules-date-anomaly, resolved).
how: Read the latest weekly report against the experiment ledger.

title: Meta dataset secrets and SKAdNetwork ids set or recorded as pending
what: Meta dataset secrets, the webhook auth and the two SKAdNetwork ids are set, or recorded as pending. The server-side path needs no SDK and no ATT; a build that adds the Meta SDK follows submission.tracking-answers-match-att-and-manifest (conflict tracking-and-att, resolved).
how: Owner sets the secrets once. A Meta test event is the proof.

title: RevenueCat to Amplitude integration on
what: The RevenueCat to Amplitude integration is on with the stated settings, and the app sets the Amplitude device id attribute.
how: Owner clicks in the dashboard. Verify in RevenueCat customer attributes.

title: RevenueCat to Apple Search Ads integration on
what: The RevenueCat to Apple Search Ads integration is on by OAuth.
how: Owner: two clicks in the dashboard.

title: Revenue events come from RevenueCat only
what: Revenue events come from RevenueCat only. The app emits none.
how: Search the app for revenue event emission.

title: Server destinations wired
what: Server destinations are wired and read the app's env names.
how: Find events in each destination dashboard.

title: One screenId vocabulary
what: Onboarding events use one screenId vocabulary. The feedback trail is separate.
how: Read the event catalog.

title: Analytics subdomain and worker route live
what: The analytics.<domain> DNS record and the worker route are live.
how: Owner adds the DNS record and the route.

title: SaaS tools bought by the company
what: SaaS tools are bought by the company, with company invoices.
how: Owner keeps the invoice. Details stay in the private playbook.

title: Each vendor UI shows a real event
what: Each vendor UI shows a real event. A collector accept response is not proof.
how: Find the event in Amplitude, the Meta test events view and RevenueCat attributes.

title: Web ad pixels load through Zaraz
what: Web ad pixels load through Cloudflare Zaraz.
how: A person configures it in the browser.

title: Weekly readout scheduled
what: A weekly report agent writes docs/reports/<app>/YYYY-WW.md.
how: Check for the report files. The app-reporting skill covers daily reports.

title: Age rating questionnaire complete
what: The age rating questionnaire has no null field. New question groups are included.
how: Read ageRatingDeclaration by API; owner answers in ASC.

title: Assets localized per storefront
what: Asset images and overlay text are localized per storefront.
how: Compare the sets across localizations.

title: Assets meet a 4+ standard
what: Each asset meets a 4+ standard.
how: Visual check.

title: Assets show no price, discount, URL or copyright symbol
what: No asset shows a price, a discount, a URL or a copyright symbol.
how: Read each asset; rg the overlay copy.

title: Assets make no unverifiable claim
what: No asset has an unverifiable claim, a self-attributed award, or an Apple recognition that was not given.
how: Read the overlay copy.

title: Each metadata experiment has a recorded baseline
what: Each metadata experiment records version, fields, storefront and baseline positions.
how: Write a dated record before the change.

title: Content rights and territories set
what: Content rights and availability territories are set.
how: Read the app attributes by API.

title: Device-only screens captured on a device
what: Screens that the simulator cannot render are captured on a real device.
how: A person captures the screens on hardware.

title: Terms of Use link in the App Description
what: The Terms of Use link is in the App Description. ASC has no field for it.
how: Read the description.

title: First three screenshots ordered for the search result
what: The first three screenshots and previews are ordered as the search result set.
how: Read the ordered set in ASC.

title: Focal art in the safe area, previewed
what: Focal art is centered in the safe area, and the ASC Preview tool is used.
how: Use the ASC Preview tool.

title: Header and search creative assets exist or the skip is recorded
what: Product page header and search creative assets exist, or the skip decision is recorded.
how: Check the ASC Asset Library, or write the skip note.

title: In-App Event art in both ratios
what: In-App Event art exists in 16:9 and 9:16 with no badge copy. Applies only when an event exists.
how: Read the event assets.

title: Keywords fields within 100 characters
what: Each keywords field is 100 characters or less.
how: Use the ASC counter or the validator.

title: Metadata has no forbidden terms
what: Description and promo text have no other platforms, prices, placeholders or 'For Kids'.
how: Read and grep the ASC description by hand.

title: Name within 30 characters; no competitor keywords
what: The app name is 30 characters or less. Keywords have no competitor or trademark terms.
how: Count the characters; read the keyword fields.

title: Name and subtitle final before submit
what: Name and subtitle are final, because they lock at submission.
how: Owner confirms both fields before the Submit click.

title: Non-English metadata checked by a native speaker
what: Non-English metadata has a native-speaker check before publish.
how: A native speaker reads each field.

title: Preview poster frame stands alone
what: The preview poster frame is clear without playback.
how: Visual check.

title: App preview works muted and loops
what: The app preview works muted, loops with no seam, and has no quick cuts.
how: Play it muted.

title: Screenshots are an ad sequence
what: Store screenshots are an ad sequence: headline first (8 words or less, outcome not feature), order pain, shift, proof, feature; hand test before publish; judge by 30-day conversion.
how: Write the headlines before you pick screens. Cover the UI and read only the text. Record the 30-day App Analytics conversion.

title: Screenshots show real UI from the current build
what: Screenshots show real UI from the current build. No title art, no CTA slab, no fabricated UI, no TestFlight status bar.
how: Diff each screenshot against a fresh capture. See also the skills aso-appstore-screenshots and the vendored screenshot references.

title: Required screenshot set uploaded, no alpha
what: The 6.9 inch iPhone screenshot set is uploaded, with no alpha channel. Only that set is required; pixel sizes are read from Apple's specification page at export time (conflict screenshot-sizes, resolved).
how: Owner uploads (no upload tooling). Verify: API appScreenshotSets is not empty; `sips -g hasAlpha` on each file.

title: Secondary English locales with distinct keywords
what: If secondary English locales are added, each keyword field is distinct and a baseline is recorded first. The added US coverage and the locale weights are unverified assumptions (2026-09-15); they justify no keyword allocation (conflict aso-cross-localization, resolved).
how: Owner pastes the fields into ASC only after a baseline exists (see aso.change-recorded-with-baseline). Measure the effect; do not treat the 400-character claim as a rule.

title: Support and marketing URLs on every localization
what: Support and marketing URLs are set on each localization.
how: Read the localizations by API.

title: Shareable surfaces carry the capture-seal watermark
what: Each screenshot-shareable surface carries the capture-seal watermark.
how: Apply growth trick 2. The alarm test for the canvas lookup is the guard.

title: A concrete external loss beats an abstract counter
what: An externalized, concrete loss works better than an abstract counter.
how: Use as design guidance.

title: Interactive controls have accessibility identifiers
what: Interactive controls have accessibility identifiers for selector-based driving.
how: Drive the screen with the simulator tools; a control you cannot select by id fails. See the sim-test and axe skills.

title: First version is onboarding, monetization and core loop only
what: The first version contains only onboarding, monetization and the core loop (conflict wiki-p01-vs-p08, resolved: the rule limits the number of parts, not the length of onboarding).
how: List the v1 scope in the app doc. Cut anything outside the three parts. Onboarding length is governed by build.longer-onboarding-wins, not by this rule.

title: Full test tier runs before push
what: The full test tier runs before push. The affected-tests tier is for iteration only and is never evidence that a branch is green.
how: Run the repo vitest gate and the app's native gate. Keep the command output.

title: Growth tricks ledger read before first TestFlight
what: The growth tricks ledger is read for build-time entries before the first TestFlight build.
how: Read the ledger; note which tricks need build-time work.

title: Screens scroll in iPad iPhone-compat mode
what: No screen uses an exact-height viewport. Content and bottom buttons stay reachable when review runs an iPhone-only app on iPad.
how: Use the min-height fill viewport for SDUI screens. A scan test guards the pattern. Run the app on an iPad simulator in compat mode. The ledger entry (2026-08-13, Guideline 4) is still open.

title: Longer onboarding beats shorter
what: Longer onboarding wins, and only large changes move the number. Conflicts wiki-p01-vs-p08 and wiki-moonly-vs-decided-rules are resolved: the rule stands; the concept page is evidence, not a decision.
how: Use as design guidance, not as a per-app check.

title: No preconditionFailure traps in Release code
what: Release code has no preconditionFailure trap where an empty state works.
how: Search the app and shared Swift packages for preconditionFailure; replace each with an empty state or a logged error.

title: DEBUG QA launch arguments exist
what: DEBUG `-qa*` launch arguments exist, with a doc table.
how: Add the arguments and the table per the iteration loop playbook, step 3.

title: QA switch to review as a new customer
what: Settings has a Debug-and-TestFlight-only switch that hides the entitlement.
how: Port the switch and its tests from the reference app. Keep the App Store channel test.

title: One sandbox tester per test scenario
what: One fresh sandbox tester exists per purchase test scenario.
how: Create the testers in ASC (owner or operator action).

title: First value moment comes before the paywall
what: The first value moment comes before the paywall. With a hard paywall after onboarding, that moment sits inside onboarding.
how: Walk the onboarding flow and name the screen that gives the value moment. It must come before the paywall screen.

title: Widget or OS surface exists for re-entry
what: The app uses widgets or other OS surfaces as a re-entry lever.
how: Name the OS surface the app ships (widget, Lock Screen, quick action).

title: Competitor screen study recorded
what: A named competitor screen study exists, with a patterns file in the app research folder.
how: Follow the six-step study protocol. Save patterns.md under apps/<app>/docs/research/.

title: Demand receipts exist
what: Demand receipts exist for the category: competitor revenue, reviews, paid ads, creator content, store rank.
how: List each receipt with a link in the verdict card. An empty category means no demand until proven otherwise.

title: Built-in distribution loop named
what: The built-in distribution loop is named. A channel is not a loop.
how: Name the loop in the verdict card. Reject an answer that is only a channel.

title: Free/paid line, price anchor and payer named
what: The free/paid line, the price anchor, and who pays versus who uses are named before monetization is scored.
how: Write the three items in the verdict card before the monetization score.

title: Hardest risk and dated kill criterion named
what: The hardest risk is named, with one numeric kill criterion that has a date.
how: Write the risk, the number and the date in the verdict card.

title: Idea fits one sentence
what: The idea fits one sentence that a stranger understands. No sentence means no verdict.
how: Write the sentence in the idea doc or verdict card. Ask a person outside the project to restate it. The Idea Roast hard kill K1 is the same test.

title: Market sized by paying intent
what: The market is sized by paying-intent bands, not by headcount.
how: Apply the paying-intent bands from the concept page to the reachable audience. Record the bands in the verdict card.

title: Paywall is derived for the audience, not copied
what: A paywall is never a one-to-one copy of a known paywall. It is derived again for the intent and demographics of the audience (conflict wiki-p05-vs-g10-p16, resolved: three rules on three surfaces).
how: Use competitor paywalls as input to a design for this audience. Do not merge this rule with the content-format rule (G-10) or the benchmark gate (P-16); they cover different surfaces.

title: Idea Roast verdict recorded
what: A recorded Idea Roast verdict exists before any build time. No recorded roast means no build.
how: Run the hard kills K1-K13 and the soft flags S1-S5. Record the verdict line in the idea doc or issue. K11 checks App Review exposure against the rejection ledger.

refs.locator: Hard kills, Soft flags, Verdict line

title: Idea scored on evidence, monetization and loop
what: Evidence, monetization and built-in loop each get a 0-5 score. Novelty scores zero.
how: Record the three scores in the verdict card (the /app-idea skill writes this card).

title: Transaction-abandonment placement discounts the annual plan only
what: A transaction-abandonment placement is not required. If one exists, its discount applies to the annual plan only, and it is the single, time-separated offer after a decline, never a second offer (conflicts wiki-p15-vs-p09 and abandonment-placement-vs-offer-burst, resolved: the 2026-08-13 Guideline 5.6 rejection wins; the placement was deleted 2026-08-14).
how: Read the placement config. If the placement exists, walk the decline path and confirm it is the only offer. Check the rejection ledger before you add or restore the placement.

title: Annual preselected, few plans, no comparison table
what: The annual plan is preselected, the plan count is small, and there is no comparison table (conflict wiki-moonly-vs-decided-rules, resolved: the rule stands).
how: Screenshot the paywall default state.

title: Every live product id is in the client entitlement list
what: Each live ASC product id is in the client entitlement-match list. The match list is not the display catalog.
how: Diff the API product list against the client list.

title: Auto-renew statement visible
what: The 'auto-renews until canceled' statement is visible.
how: Screenshot the paywall.

title: Live-screen benchmarks pulled before a pricing, paywall or onboarding change
what: Current live-screen benchmarks are pulled before any change to pricing, paywall layout or onboarding prompts. Benchmark evidence is a gate and an input; it is never a copy source (conflict wiki-p05-vs-g10-p16, resolved).
how: Run an Appllama study first and link it from the change.

title: Billed amount is the most prominent price
what: The billed amount is the most prominent price. Per-period equivalents are subordinate.
how: Screenshot each plan card; compare type sizes.

title: Earned-discount presentation is not a random spin
what: An earned-discount reveal is certain and identical for every user. No spin wheel, odds or random element decides the discount (conflict spin-wheel-discount, resolved: the shipped reveal is the certain version; the random version is forbidden).
how: Read the discount reveal on the paywall path. The result must not depend on chance, and the copy must not say that it does.

title: Entitlements are roles, enforced on the server
what: Entitlements are roles, not one paid boolean, and the server enforces them.
how: Name the roles and the place where the server checks them.

title: Freemium only with a strong paid outcome; winback does not lead with discount
what: Freemium exists only if the paid outcome stays compelling after the free feature. Winback reconnects to the original outcome and does not lead with a discount. A paywall-close rescue pass is not a winback (conflict wiki-p15-vs-p13, resolved).
how: Read the winback surface copy; the first message is the outcome.

title: Hard paywall directly after onboarding
what: A hard paywall sits directly after onboarding. Conflicts wiki-p02-vs-p06 and wiki-moonly-vs-decided-rules are resolved: the rule stands.
how: Walk the first-run flow; the paywall follows the last onboarding screen.

title: Launch discounts use offer codes
what: Launch discounts use subscription offer codes, not IAP promo codes.
how: Configure an offer code in ASC.

title: Manage or cancel subscription path reachable
what: A cancel or manage subscription path is reachable in the app.
how: rg for the manage-subscriptions call, or open the Settings link on a device.

title: No external purchase steering
what: No text or link steers the user to an external purchase path.
how: rg -i for external checkout vendor names and externalPurchase; expect zero hits.

title: No fabricated social proof
what: Testimonials are real. No invented names, stars or staged assets.
how: Trace each testimonial to a real source.

title: No fake scarcity or countdown
what: No countdown timer or false scarcity line is shown, including a 'limited spots' line on a price sheet (conflict limited-spots-line, resolved: the conservative option).
how: Read the paywall and offer copy.

title: No orphan IAP attached
what: No unused IAP is attached to the submission. The attached set matches the binary; the product count is read from the ASC API, never from a doc (conflicts subscription-count and lifetime-product, resolved).
how: List the attached products in ASC; rg each product id in the code.

title: No star-rating gate before the review prompt
what: No star-rating gate comes before a review prompt.
how: Search for a rating pre-prompt in the review request path.

title: No trial toggle on any paywall
what: No paywall has a toggle that adds or removes a free trial. Apple rejected it under Guideline 3.1.2(c) and asked for removal (conflict trial-toggle-tactic, resolved: the application map row is stale).
how: Three guards exist: the binary ignores the toggle key, the flow validator rejects it at publish time, and an absence test fails on any control that binds to the swap. Run the app test gate and the SDUI validate script.

title: No unminted code is visible in the app
what: No visible in-app code exists that is not minted. Reachability is traced in code.
how: Trace each code surface in a Release build path; compare with the offerCodes API.

title: Paywall sits at the peak of user effort
what: The paywall sits at the peak of invested user effort.
how: Name the effort step that comes directly before the paywall.

title: Paywall-close rescue offer shape
what: A paywall-close rescue may be a repeatable low-price non-renewing offer; no free access is granted for a decline. A decline returns to the gate and does not complete onboarding. Deeper discounts need cancelled or expired trial evidence. The pass is not a subscription discount (P-09) and not a winback (P-13). Conflicts wiki-p15-vs-p09, wiki-p15-vs-p13 and free-rescue-pass are resolved.
how: Walk the paywall close path. Compare with the review notes of the submitted version.

title: Paywall Terms and Privacy links resolve
what: The paywall has tappable Terms (EULA) and Privacy Policy links, and both return 200.
how: Tap both links; curl both URLs and read the status code.

title: Paywall usable when remote config is unreachable
what: The paywall stays usable when remote config is unreachable.
how: Open the paywall on a device in Airplane Mode.

title: All paywall placements exist before A/B tests
what: The placements exist before any A/B test: onboarding, session start, after-N-actions, trial-cancel, subscription-cancel. Transaction abandonment counts only when it is the single offer after a decline; it is never an extra offer (conflicts wiki-moonly-vs-decided-rules and abandonment-placement-vs-offer-burst, resolved: the 2026-08-13 Guideline 5.6 rejection wins).
how: List the placements and the surface for each one. If a transaction-abandonment placement exists, confirm it is the only post-decline offer.

title: Paywall shows plan title and duration
what: Each paywall surface shows the subscription title and duration.
how: Take one screenshot per paywall surface.

title: Product ids are set-equal across all four places
what: Product ids are set-equal across code, the .storekit file, RevenueCat and ASC (conflict paywall-vendor, resolved: RevenueCat replaced Adapty on 2026-07-31).
how: Diff the four lists.

title: Purchase controls do what the label says
what: Each labelled purchase control does what its label says.
how: Tap each control on a device.

title: Remote paywall schema has the legal fields
what: Each remote paywall schema has terms, privacy and a non-optional restore. The live config is read, not only the schema.
how: Read the schema, then fetch the live config.

title: Remote URL sinks have an allowlist
what: Remote-config URL sinks have a scheme and host allowlist.
how: rg the openURL sinks; each one checks the allowlist.

title: Restore Purchases reachable and clean
what: Restore Purchases is on the paywall and in Settings, and gives a clean result.
how: On a device with no purchase, tap Restore in both places.

title: A declining user meets one offer, time-separated from the next
what: A user who declines the paywall does not meet a burst of cheaper offers. Apple rejected repeated offers under Guideline 5.6. The one offer is the paid non-renewing pass; no free access follows a decline, and the winback is time-separated (conflicts free-rescue-pass and abandonment-placement-vs-offer-burst, resolved).
how: Walk the decline path on a device and count the offer surfaces. The ledger entry (2026-08-13) is still open; its fix plan names scan tests.

title: RETIRED: trial toggle with dual pricing
what: Retired tactic: a paywall toggle that swaps between a trial product and a pay-now product. Struck 2026-08-12 after the 3.1.2(c) rejection. Superseded by monetization.no-trial-toggle. Conflict trial-toggle-tactic is resolved: the application map row is stale.
how: Do not ship. Kept so that old references resolve.

title: Subscription prices cover all territories
what: The price count equals the territory count for each subscription. MISSING_METADATA most often means incomplete territory pricing.
how: Count prices and territories by API (`subs.ts verify`).

title: Subscription review notes match the offers
what: Each subscription review note matches its configured intro offer as read from ASC at submission time; no doc value is authoritative (conflict trial-lengths, resolved).
how: Compare the notes with the offers by API; edit in ASC.

title: Each subscription has a review screenshot
what: Each subscription has a review screenshot. Without it the subscription reads MISSING_METADATA.
how: Read subscriptionAppStoreReviewScreenshots by API.

title: First-time subscriptions attached to the version submission
what: First-time subscriptions are attached to the version review submission, winback and non-renewing products included. The count is read from the ASC API (conflict subscription-count, resolved).
how: Owner checks the In-App Purchases section of the ASC version. Count the products from the ASC API, not from a doc.

title: Trial anxiety limits trial starts
what: Trial anxiety, not value communication, limits trial starts (conflict wiki-moonly-vs-decided-rules, resolved: the rule stands).
how: Use as paywall design guidance.

title: A promised trial reminder is sent
what: If the paywall promises a trial reminder, the app sends it.
how: Start a sandbox trial and wait for the reminder.

title: Trial terms visible
what: Trial length and what happens at trial end are visible on the paywall.
how: Screenshot the paywall with a trial product.

title: Agent-made ad campaigns start paused
what: Each agent-made ad campaign starts paused. A person enables it.
how: Create with status paused.

title: Exact campaigns funded before Discovery
what: Exact campaigns are funded before Discovery at a 3-4 to 1 ratio, with negatives.
how: Read the campaign structure.

title: No budget or bid change in the learning window
what: No budget or max CPT change occurs in the first two weeks. Later changes are monthly. The source cadence is monthly.
how: Read the change log before any edit.

title: ASO proposals applied only in the monthly window
what: ASO watch proposals are applied only in the monthly change window.
how: Hold proposals until the window.

title: Budget weeks to months of flat results
what: Budget weeks to months of flat results before you judge a channel.
how: General knowledge. Use when you plan creator or content work; no per-app status.

title: Collector accepts synthetic events under one app id
what: The collector accepts synthetic waitlist_joined and store_clicked events, and reports show one app id.
how: Send the two events; read the collector and the report.

title: Copy a proven content format
what: Copy a proven content format and change only surface variables. This covers content, not paywalls (conflict wiki-p05-vs-g10-p16, resolved).
how: General knowledge. Use when you plan creator or content work; no per-app status.

title: Creator CAC includes all costs
what: Creator CAC is fee plus coordination, revisions, rights, analytics, variance and repeatability.
how: General knowledge. Use when you plan creator or content work; no per-app status.

title: Creator pay is base plus non-stacking milestones
what: The creator pay structure is a base plus non-stacking milestone bonuses.
how: General knowledge. Use when you plan creator or content work; no per-app status.

title: Select creators on comment engagement
what: Creators are selected on comment engagement, never on follower count.
how: General knowledge. Use when you plan creator or content work; no per-app status.

title: Deploy and rollback commands logged
what: The deploy command, the prior worker version and the rollback command are logged.
how: Write the log entry.

title: Every video shows the product
what: Every video shows the product on screen. The wow moment must be filmable. The wiki counts this as a per-video check, so it has no per-app status.
how: General knowledge. Use when you plan creator or content work; no per-app status.

title: Crash reports and the uat issue monitored in the first week
what: Sentry and the uat issue are monitored in the first week. First fixes ride the same TestFlight loop.
how: Read Sentry daily in week one.

title: Growth tricks turned on and recorded
what: Growth tricks worth using are turned on, and the ledger status row and the app's offer doc are updated. The trick 1 in-app surface was removed on 2026-08-14; a ledger row that still says shipped is stale until edited (conflict offer-code-surface, resolved).
how: Edit the status rows after each change.

title: Guardrail metrics monitored
what: No experiment makes a guardrail metric worse without a report. A guardrail for a surface that no longer exists (the automatic rescue grant) is retired from the list before the next report (conflict free-rescue-pass, resolved).
how: Read the guardrails in the app's METRICS.md in each weekly report.

title: Launch-gated items run on approval
what: The launch-gated items are run on approval, each with a date and an evidence link.
how: Run the kb checklist for phase post-launch. The app's LAUNCH_CHECKLIST.md keeps app-specific prose.

title: Main version bumped above the approved version
what: MARKETING_VERSION on main is set above the approved version on the same day.
how: Merge the bump PR.

title: Offer code minted after a channel decision
what: The offer code is minted after the owner decides the distribution channel. No in-app redemption surface exists since 2026-08-14, so the channel is off-app or a new surface checked against the rejection ledger (conflict offer-code-surface, resolved).
how: Owner decides the channel. Then run the one API call in the app's offer code runbook.

title: Offer code redeemed on a real device
what: The offer code is redeemed on a real device and shows the right discount (conflict offer-code-surface, resolved: the quick-action sheet no longer exists).
how: A person redeems the code on hardware through the chosen channel (App Store redemption link or a new surface). Do not follow the old quick-action step.

title: Public listing opens signed out
what: The public App Store URL opens the right listing in a signed-out browser.
how: curl the URL for a 200, then open it in a signed-out browser.

title: Each rejection gets a ledger entry and a new rule
what: Each rejection gets a REJECTIONS.md entry (Apple's words, root cause, fix, guard, lesson) and a new playbook rule with a verify command.
how: Write both. Then add or revise the requirement record here and bump its revision.

title: Sell the outcome, not the mechanic
what: Sell the outcome, not the mechanic.
how: General knowledge. Use when you plan creator or content work; no per-app status.

title: Site build uses the matching language and environment
what: The domain build uses the matching language and Wrangler environment. The environment is set at build time.
how: Read the generated config.

title: Site privacy policy matches the deployed analytics
what: The site privacy policy names the analytics behaviour that is deployed.
how: Compare the policy with the deployed config.

title: Views and conversions are decoupled
what: Views and conversions are decoupled. Viewer intent decides, not the call to action.
how: General knowledge. Use when you plan creator or content work; no per-app status.

title: Waitlist KV bound to the intended environment
what: The waitlist KV is bound to the intended worker environment.
how: Check the deployed binding.

title: What agents may do without asking
what: Agents may do these without asking: experiment ledger files, offering and metadata prep, copy-string-only experiments in the fail-closed class, weekly reports, guardrail-breach flags. The status date 2026-08-01 is the growth-ops ratification date (conflict wiki-autonomy-rules-date-anomaly, resolved).
how: Agent policy. Everything outside this list follows release.human-go-for-price-product-flow-changes.

title: Appeal only after a full Resolution Center reply
what: The one appeal per rejection is used only after a full Resolution Center reply.
how: Owner replies in Resolution Center first.

title: No open blocker:testflight issue
what: No open blocker:testflight issue exists before a build ships.
how: `gh issue list --label blocker:testflight` returns nothing.

title: Shipped build contains the work, proven by commit ancestry
what: The shipped build contains the work. Prove it by commit ancestry, not by run number; a canceled run can still upload a build.
how: Read the build's source commit and check that the work commit is an ancestor. Prove a tag start by sourceBranchOrTag, never by timestamps.

title: Release build attached to the beta group and reads IN_BETA_TESTING
what: The release build is added to the beta group. Delivery is reported only after Cloud success, ASC VALID and IN_BETA_TESTING.
how: POST the build to the beta group, then poll buildBetaDetail.internalBuildState. The betaGroups relationship read is not reliable.

title: Build version comes from the tag
what: The build's marketing version comes from the tag, not from the frozen repo value. Release-tag runs are App Store eligible; merge-to-main runs are internal only.
how: GET /v1/builds/{id}?include=preReleaseVersion.

title: Distribution starts before App Store approval
what: Distribution work starts before App Store approval.
how: Name the channel work that is live before approval. The vendored app-launch skill gives a sequence.

title: External TestFlight has a demo account and a privacy URL
what: External TestFlight (Beta App Review) has a working demo account with populated content and a reachable privacy policy URL.
how: Log in with the demo account; curl the privacy URL. Never store the credentials in these records.

title: Price, product, trial-length, flow-JSON and hard-lock changes need a human go
what: Price or product changes, flow-JSON KV publishes, trial-length changes, stopping or shipping an arm, and hard-lock surface changes each need an explicit human go. The status date 2026-08-01 is the growth-ops ratification date (conflict wiki-autonomy-rules-date-anomaly, resolved).
how: Ask, name the exact change, and wait for the go. A flow-JSON publish reaches all users, not one arm.

title: Internal build number reported after merge
what: After a merge the agent reports the internal build number that has the work.
how: Read the build number from ASC and state it.

title: No expedited review for a launch
what: No expedited review request is made for a launch.
how: Do not file the request.

title: Submission has a second explicit owner go; the owner clicks Submit
what: Submission for review has a second explicit owner go. The Submit click is owner-only.
how: Wait for the explicit go. Prepare everything else; the owner clicks Submit.

title: Owner tested the build and said 'tag it'
what: A release tag is cut only after the owner tested the internal build and said 'tag it' for that build. Agents never tag (conflict who-may-cut-release, resolved).
how: Wait for the owner statement that names the build. The owner runs the release recipe, or names the runner in that statement. The recipe takes positional arguments.

title: A rejected build number is never resubmitted
what: A rejected build number is never resubmitted. A rejection needs a new build.
how: Compare the attached build number with the rejected one in the ledger.

title: Release run appears after the tag, or it is started by hand
what: A release run appears within 15 minutes of the tag. If none appears, it is started by hand on the tag ref (conflict release-start-mode-and-testflight-path, resolved).
how: Watch Xcode Cloud. Manual start: ASC UI, Xcode Cloud, Start Build, pick the tag ref.

title: TestFlight first; submission only after the owner confirms the build
what: Each build goes to TestFlight first: a merge to main ships the TestFlight build, and a release build needs an owner tag. The App Store submission step happens only after the owner tests the TestFlight build (conflict release-start-mode-and-testflight-path, resolved).
how: Land the PR, get the internal build, and let the owner test it on a device. Record the build number that the owner tested.

title: Device checks added to the uat issue
what: Device checks are added to the app's open uat issue as concrete checkbox steps with the PR link.
how: Edit the uat-labelled issue. TestFlight feedback is qualitative only.

title: Version state watched; same-day Resolution Center reply
what: The version state is watched and Resolution Center questions get a same-day reply. The ASC API exposes no rejection text.
how: Owner reads Resolution Center in the ASC web UI or the Apple mailbox.

title: Amplitude EU project exists with its key as a worker secret
what: An Amplitude EU project exists and its API key is a worker secret (conflict secret-naming, resolved: the Worker binding is unprefixed per env; the GitHub and SOPS copies carry the app prefix).
how: Owner creates the project. Set the key as a worker secret. A test event in Amplitude realtime is the proof.

title: App identity decided before scaffold
what: Name, app directory, bundle id and domain are decided before the template copy (conflict japanese-bundle-id, resolved: the playbook example is illustrative; the registry holds the id).
how: Decide the four values. Read the bundle id from the ASC registry and project.yml, not from the playbook example.

title: ASC API credentials verified
what: The ASC API credentials mint a token and the state script returns data.
how: Run scripts/asc/state.ts for the app; expect data, not an auth error. Key locations stay in the private playbook.

title: App Store Connect app record exists
what: The App Store Connect app record exists. The API cannot create it.
how: Owner creates the record in the ASC UI. Record the ASC app id.

title: App registered in the ASC script registry
what: The app has an entry in scripts/asc/apps.json.
how: Add the entry; run state.ts for the app and read the output.

title: ASO watch configured for the app
what: The app has aso/watch.json, a first run, a README and a scheduler entry.
how: Follow 'New app in four steps'. Raw output is committed under docs/aso/<slug>/raw/.

title: Bundle ids and capabilities registered
what: The bundle id and each extension id are registered with the needed capabilities (conflict extension-bundle-id-suffix, resolved: the widget extension suffix is .widgets).
how: Register ids by API or portal; read them back. Take the extension ids from ios/project.yml, not from the setup kit table.

title: Apple Developer Program active
what: The paid Apple Developer Program membership is active.
how: Owner reads the ASC Membership page.

title: Domain on org DNS with MX records
what: The domain points at org DNS and has MX records.
how: Owner sets DNS. Verify: `dig +short MX <domain>` returns records.

title: Metric contract file defined
what: apps/<app>/docs/METRICS.md defines the funnel and the guardrails with exact event names.
how: Copy the template METRICS.md and fill it. The file is the evidence.

title: Paid Applications agreement active
what: The Paid Applications agreement, banking and tax forms are complete.
how: Owner reads ASC Agreements; the row shows Active.

title: Profiles regenerated after a capability change
what: Provisioning profiles are regenerated after each capability change.
how: Regenerate, then archive and export; both must complete.

title: Subscription vendor project configured
what: The RevenueCat project, app and offering exist, and the public SDK key is in ios/project.yml (conflict paywall-vendor, resolved: RevenueCat replaced Adapty on 2026-07-31).
how: Create project, app and offering in the RevenueCat dashboard. Put only the public SDK key in project.yml.

title: SDUI flow copies are byte-identical
what: The three onboarding flow JSON copies are byte-identical.
how: Run diff on the three copies; expect empty output. Later the app's vitest gate asserts this.

title: SDUI KV namespace and worker envs exist
what: The SDUI KV namespace, both worker env blocks and the SDUI admin token exist for the app.
how: Manual deployment step from the bootstrap checklist.

title: App listed in the Sentry project map
what: The app is listed in the Sentry project map and in the triage skill map.
how: Add the table row in the Sentry playbook and the skill map.

title: Sentry project registered and DSN wired
what: A Sentry project exists for the app and the DSN is wired.
how: Follow 'Register a new app' in the Sentry playbook.

title: Special entitlement enabled on every target id
what: Each special-request entitlement is present and enabled on every target bundle id (conflict family-controls-grant-scope, resolved: on this team the toggle appears for a new id without a new request, 2026-09-08).
how: Owner checks the portal toggle for each id. A signed archive that exports is the proof. If the toggle is missing for a new id, file the request for that App ID.

title: Per-app submission state file seeded
what: The per-app submission state exists with an evidence column. Since this migration the tracking file under kb-site/data/tracking/ is the state; the app doc keeps prose only (see docs/MIGRATION.md).
how: Historic procedure: copy submission playbook section 9 into the app's APP_STORE_SUBMISSION.md. New procedure: run the kb checklist for the app.

title: Subscriptions exist and read READY_TO_SUBMIT
what: All subscriptions exist and read READY_TO_SUBMIT (conflict subscription-rerun-safety, resolved: a re-run does not repair a partial create, Correction 2026-09-08).
how: Run the subs recipe create step with the operator present, then `subs.ts verify`. After a partial failure, do not trust a bare re-run; read the correction in the bootstrap playbook.

title: Template scaffold verified
what: The scaffold has no placeholders, no reference-app strings, a valid SDUI flow, and it generates the project.
how: Run the verify block of the new-app playbook: rg for placeholders returns nothing, the SDUI validate script exits 0, the flow diff is empty.

title: Template source lines removed
what: All 'Template source' comment lines and the template README are removed from the new app.
how: grep for 'Template source' in the app directory; expect no match.

title: TestFlight workflow has post-action and tester group
what: The TestFlight workflow has the post-action and a tester group.
how: UI-only manual steps in ASC bootstrap Phase 5.

title: Xcode Cloud release and TestFlight workflows exist
what: A release workflow (tag start) and a TestFlight workflow (main branch, repo-relative path) exist. Xcode Cloud is the build path; EAS is not (conflicts release-start-mode-and-testflight-path and build-upload-tool, resolved).
how: Create both with the workflows recipe. The recipe readback asserts tagStartCondition.

title: Account deletion path exists or position stated
what: An account deletion path exists, or the review notes state why it does not apply.
how: Owner decides. Put the sentence in the review notes.

title: In-app control to withdraw analytics consent
what: Settings has a control to withdraw analytics consent. This is a submission gate; an app that deferred it keeps the item open until it ships (conflict analytics-consent-toggle, resolved).
how: Check the Settings screen.

title: One app group across all targets
what: One app group id is used by the app and all extensions.
how: rg the app group key in entitlements; expect one id.

title: Signed device archive check is clean
what: The signed device archive passes the link-map, resource and entitlement policy.
how: Run the signed device archive check (`SIGN=1 just lang archive-check-device`). Expect 'archive-inspect: clean' plus five match lines. The simulator variant is a loop check, not evidence.

title: ATT states verified on device
what: Allow, deny, restricted and revocation ATT states are checked on a device for any build that ships an ATT prompt (conflict tracking-and-att, resolved).
how: Run the four states on a real device with the build that ships the ATT prompt.

title: Binary locales match ASC localizations
what: Binary locales match the ASC localizations.
how: Compare the project's localizations with the ASC localization list.

title: Build state is VALID
what: The build state is VALID.
how: Read the build by API (ASC bootstrap Phase 7).

title: Cold launch works in hostile conditions
what: A fresh Release install is usable with no data, no network, and permissions denied.
how: Run on a device with the exact build that is submitted: fresh install, Airplane Mode, deny each permission.

title: A competitor running a pattern is not compliance evidence
what: A live app that runs a pattern is not evidence that Apple approves it. A paywall pattern lives in the binary and in the remote config; guard both.
how: Use when you assess a paywall or onboarding tactic taken from another app.

title: Compiled secrets are low risk and documented
what: Each compiled secret is write-only or low risk, and is documented.
how: Run strings on the binary; match each hit to the app docs.

title: Entitlement claims verified on the uploaded binary
what: Entitlement claims are verified against the binary Apple received, not against source.
how: GET /v1/builds/{id}?include=buildBundles. The entitlements dict is keyed by mach-o path; a top-level grep reads as absent.

title: Export compliance answered for the build
what: Export compliance is answered for the build.
how: TestFlight shows no compliance warning on the build.

title: Export compliance key set in Info.plist
what: ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption is set in Info.plist.
how: rg ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption in the iOS directory.

title: Feedback recorder absent from the submitted build
what: Feedback env vars exist only on the TestFlight workflow. The submitted build has no Send Feedback row and shake does nothing.
how: Owner checks the workflow env vars in the Xcode Cloud UI. On the submitted build: check Settings on a device and grep the IPA plist with plutil.

refs.locator: B7, Verify on the submitted build

title: 1024 icon has no alpha
what: The 1024 app icon exists with no alpha channel.
how: Check the asset catalog; `sips -g hasAlpha` on the file.

title: Identity golden matches
what: Resolved bundle ids, entitlements, app groups and plist keys match the identity golden.
how: Run the identity-golden vitest with its env flag, as written in the submission playbook 2.16.

title: Intended build attached to the version
what: The build attached to the version is the intended, App Store eligible build. The version string equals the ASC record exactly.
how: Read the build id and number by API. Release-tag runs are eligible; merge-to-main runs are internal only.

title: Launch-day site flip prepared
what: The waitlist-to-store-badge change is ready as a PR or a documented step.
how: Link the PR.

title: Privacy, Terms and Support URLs return 200
what: Privacy, Terms and Support URLs return 200 on the live domain.
how: curl each URL with a cache-bust query; expect 200.

title: Listed SDKs ship signed privacy manifests
what: Each SDK on Apple's third-party SDK list ships a signed privacy manifest. The transitive graph is included.
how: Compare the resolved package graph with Apple's list.

title: Live shield fixture decodes on the new build
what: The staged-shield payload from the live version decodes on the new build.
how: Run the shield live fixture tests (`just lang test-shield ShieldLiveFixtureTests`).

title: Marketing icon is full-bleed and matches Icon Composer
what: The legacy 1024 icon is full-bleed and matches the Icon Composer render.
how: Compare the two images side by side.

title: No debug surface in Release
what: No debug or QA surface is reachable in a Release build.
how: rg for debug surfaces, then launch a Release build.

title: No surface is gated on the receipt name alone
what: No TestFlight-only surface is gated on the receipt name alone. Review builds carry a sandboxReceipt, the same as TestFlight, so a second independent gate is needed.
how: rg sandboxReceipt and trace each use to a second gate.

title: No staging endpoint in Release
what: No staging or localhost host is compiled into Release.
how: rg URL literals; list the hosts.

title: No stale product name on the site
what: No old product name stays on the site.
how: rg the old names in the web content.

title: No third-party brand icons in the binary
what: The binary ships no real third-party app icons (Guideline 5.2 risk).
how: Search the asset catalogs for brand marks of other apps.

title: No unused entitlement
what: No entitlement is present that the app does not use.
how: Read each .entitlements file.

title: No identifier carries an unshipped special capability
what: No team identifier carries a special capability that the binary does not ship.
how: Owner audits every identifier in the developer portal.

title: Paid path not gated on the core permission
what: A user who denies the core permission still reaches the paywall and the free content.
how: Device run with the permission denied. Part of the cold-launch pass.

title: Privacy policy names every outbound host
what: The privacy policy names every outbound host and data flow.
how: List URLs with rg; compare with the live policy text.

title: App Privacy labels complete and true
what: App Privacy labels are complete and true for every SDK.
how: Owner reads the labels in ASC by hand; no API exposes them. Conflict privacy-label-table (resolved) records that the older label table is stale.

title: Privacy manifest per target
what: The app and each extension have a PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy that declares required-reason APIs.
how: `fd -H xcprivacy` lists one file per target. The build that is submitted must contain them.

title: Privacy manifest tracking flags are consistent
what: NSPrivacyTracking and the tracking domains agree. Each tracking SDK domain is in the app manifest.
how: Read the app manifest against each SDK manifest. No ITMS-91064 mail arrives after upload.

title: Privacy URL on every localization
what: The privacy policy URL is set on each ASC localization.
how: Read the localizations by API.

title: Exact build smoke-tested on a real device
what: The exact build is smoke-tested on a real device by a person.
how: Record the build number and tick the boxes in the app's uat issue.

title: Recording capability disclosed
what: Any screen or audio recording capability is in the policy and in the privacy labels.
how: Search the code for recording APIs; read the policy and the labels.

title: Change cross-checked against the rejection ledger
what: The change is cross-checked against the rejection ledger before submission. Known banned patterns: skip-trial toggle, offer bursts after decline, exact-height viewports.
how: Read REJECTIONS.md and compare with the diff since the last approved version.

title: Release type chosen on purpose
what: The release type is manual for a first version. A facts table that shows release after approval records a state to change, not a rule (conflict release-type, resolved).
how: Owner sets the version release option in ASC.

title: App Review information filled
what: App Review contact, notes and demo access are filled.
how: Read appStoreReviewDetail by API; it must not be null. Owner edits in ASC.

title: Review notes explain entitlements and match the build
what: Review notes explain each unusual entitlement with test steps, and they match the submitted build.
how: Write the notes from the playbook template. Read them again against the build's behaviour before each submission.

title: Unentitled targets link no Screen Time framework
what: A target without the Family Controls entitlement links no Screen Time framework, including through re-exported imports.
how: Keep live Screen Time code in a module that only entitled targets link. The entitlement linkage scan test guards it. Measure a Release build; a Debug appex misreports linkage.

title: App shields apps, never hides them
what: The app shields apps. blockedApplications has zero hits outside tests.
how: rg blockedApplications; expect zero hits outside tests.

title: Site copy does not contradict the listing
what: Site copy does not contradict the store listing.
how: Read the live pages as a reviewer.

title: Support mailbox receives mail
what: The support mailbox has MX records and receives a real test message.
how: `dig +short MX <domain>`, then send a real message and confirm receipt. Dead mailboxes bounced silently on three org domains.

title: Terms page has real subscription terms
what: The Terms page has real subscription terms and no pre-launch text.
how: Read the live page after the site deploy.

title: Tracking answers match ATT, manifest and review notes
what: The ASC tracking answer is No unless an ATT prompt exists. ASC privacy answers and review notes agree with the manifest and the ATT behaviour of the build that ships; a build that adds the Meta SDK changes them before submission (conflict tracking-and-att, resolved).
how: rg for AppTrackingTransparency, ASIdentifierManager and NSUserTrackingUsageDescription. Zero hits means all tracking answers are No. With hits, the owner updates ASC answers and review notes before that build ships.

title: Usage descriptions are specific and used
what: Each usage description is specific and matches a real code path.
how: rg the usage description keys; match each to a code path.
